title: Safeguard Jurisdiction Rule Configuration
description: Configuration of a jurisdiction rule: the region classification for a token and the action taken when a subject's region is restricted, prohibited or unknown. This is the object carried by a policy rule of type "jurisdiction" (see policy.schema.json) and also validated standalone by adapters and CLIs.

action.description: What the rule does for a non-permitted region. Unknown regions fail closed and trigger the same action (never silently approve).

permitted.description: Regions that may hold and transact the token.

restricted.description: Regions that need review; trigger the rule action.

prohibited.description: Regions that may not transact; trigger the rule action.
